content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble accessing my [product_name]. I found one previously used by a colleague and need to use it, but every action I try in [product_name] Soft Comfort asks for a password, which I don't know. I performed a master reset, but still can't proceed. Could anyone advise?
Hello, you need to reset the password. How can you reset the password in a [product_name]? [url]

Hello, my issue isn't with the program password. I simply can't do anything in [product_name] Soft Comfort without entering a password. My device is set to factory settings, but I can't download, upload, or read any data.

Could you provide more details? Which [product_name] model do you have, including the specific article number and firmware version? Also, which version of [product_name] Soft Comfort (LSC) do you use?
Have you tried clearing the program and password online?
Did you read the post you quoted?
Did you check the quoted post? I think it could clear both the BM password and the program simultaneously.
I don't think so. That's what was written...

I believe the connection might be problematic. If [product_name] Soft Comfort waits too long for a response from the [product_name], that could be the issue, possibly due to a weak WLAN connection or incorrect IP address.
Hello, whenever I try, [product_name] Soft Comfort immediately requests a password.
Hello, I don't have a connection issue (see attachment). My problem is with the password. [product_name] Soft Comfort requires a password for any operation (read, download/upload program, etc.).
Let me repeat: I think your issue relates to the connection. [IMAGE]
Sorry, I didn't read the opening post carefully. For your [product_name] with article number [article_no], which is a [version_no], you'll need at least [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no].
Here's where you can download the upgrade to [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]. It is a complete package, about 1.3 GB in size. (Includes download, notes, and instructions.)
Okay, I'll give it a try. Thanks.

It's better to upgrade to [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], which is the latest version. The download for [product_name] Software Upgrade is export-restricted and requires additional registration. Why do you need to log in and register to download export-restricted software, and what data do you need for this? My suggestion: upgrade first to [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], then complete the additional registration, as data verification may take up to 14 days.
You could try entering the TOOL menu, select TRANSFER, then CLEAR USER PROGRAM AND PASSWORD.
I downloaded [version_no] and it works now, thank you very much.

analysis.insight_summary: Users struggle with access to [product_name] devices when passwords are unknown, even after performing factory reset and master resets. [product_name] Soft Comfort immediately prompts for a password, blocking operations such as download and upload. Connection issues or uncertainties in the password reset process add to the confusion and prevent users from moving forward.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to access and operate [product_name] devices post-reset without needing an unknown password, and are looking for clearer pathways in both software and hardware to reset or recover passwords smoothly.
